dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans applying for or participating in the VA's Veterans Readiness and Employment program.
dimensions.evidence: veterans who participate in a vocational rehabilitation program under this chapter

dimensions.assessment: Imposes documentation requirements for initial evaluations and places a 365-day limit (with potential 180-day extensions) on employment assistance.
dimensions.evidence: a veteran may not receive assistance under this subsection for more than 365 days

dimensions.assessment: Requires the VA to contract with a non-VA entity for an independent program review, but does not state specific funding amounts.
dimensions.evidence: seek to enter into a contract, with a non-Department entity that has expertise in vocational rehabilitation

dimensions.assessment: Amends federal statute governing veteran vocational rehabilitation eligibility, assistance duration, data collection, and independent review.
dimensions.evidence: amends chapter 31 of title 38, United States Code

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory changes to program rules and ongoing reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: On an annual basis, the Secretary shall make publicly available

Number of veterans impacted by the assistance duration cap
importance_detail.rationale: Makes procedural changes to the VA's Veterans Readiness and Employment program by adding application requirements, capping certain employment assistance duration, and mandating reporting and independent review.
